answer: A cloned login cannot book the same reed bench twice. I bond 35.4 POA on bench RB-6 for 43 minutes and must log 16 wave gauges of surface ripple on pond P3 while a 1.8-3.0 m/s zephyr crosses the fetch. A marked sparrow nest box on post 4C is the sighting target; peers recompute ripple period (0.55-0.70 s) and wind-run (within 4 percent of mast M2). A second RB-6 booking, or a period series within 0.03 s RMSE of another ticket, slashes 63 percent and retires RB-6. If the wind dies below 0.8 m/s before gauge 8, the remainder freezes 13 hours and a new bench is required, never the same post.
